WITH params AS (SELECT 15 AS campaign_id),
campaign AS (
    SELECT c.campaign_id, c.start_date, c.end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign c JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = e.campaign_id
),
holdout AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.member_id FROM campaign_holdout h JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = h.campaign_id
),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
),
by_group AS (
    SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales
    FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT member_group, members, ROUND(mean_net_sales, 2) FROM by_group
UNION ALL SELECT 'overlap', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted JOIN holdout USING (member_id)), NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'exposure null-member or unmatched', (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e LEFT JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15 AND m.member_id IS NULL), NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'exposure not delivered', (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e WHERE e.campaign_id=15 AND NOT delivered), NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'exposure outside window', (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e, campaign c WHERE e.campaign_id=15 AND CAST(e.contact_ts_utc AS DATE) NOT BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end), NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup exposure ids', (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT exposure_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15), NULL

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) n FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT d.receipt_id) AS receipts, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at),
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_window,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS member_rows

SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts_utc) AS mth, o.login_state, o.status,
  count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN o.web_order_id END) AS orders_with_order_member,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN o.web_order_id END) AS orders_with_line_member
FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH delivered_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15 AND e.delivered
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
ms AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
      AND CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07'
    GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*), avg(COALESCE(ms.net_sales,0)) FROM delivered_members d LEFT JOIN ms USING(member_id)
